title: Cohomology commutes with termwise direct sums
statement: For every scheme X and family of representative complexes K_i with isomorphisms Q(K_i) ≅ E_i and every integer q, the canonical map from the coproduct of the q-th cohomologies of E_i to the q-th cohomology of Q(∐ K_i) induced by the representative coprojections is an isomorphism.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.3.1, proof

proof.text: Use the Grothendieck abelian structure of module sheaves, supplied directly by upstream SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian, to obtain exact coproducts. The exact colimit functor preserves short-complex homology; termwise evaluation transfers this to complex homology. Transfer preservation through DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors, obtain the invertible sigmaComparison, and compose with the coproduct of homology of each representative isomorphism inverse.

proof_origin.place: Proof; Lean implementation adapts the private exact-colimit helpers in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtaleCechFilteredColimit

lean.statement:
theorem derivedAmbientDirectSumsHomology (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : Type u) (E : I → schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (K : I → CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (e : ∀ i : I, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (K i) ≅ E i) (q : ℤ) :
    IsIso (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) q).map
          ((e i).inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (Sigma.ι K i))))
